name: Holographic Heart
source:
An agent from the world-saving "Frieden Org" struggles with his hearts desire.

Will you make him stay forever, or move on?

[From [url=https://androidluvr800.itch.io/holoheart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
隶属于救世组织“弗里登机关”的一名特工，正为自己内心的渴望而苦苦挣扎。

你会让他永远留下，还是放手让他继续前行？

[摘自[url=https://androidluvr800.itch.io/holoheart]itch.io[/url]]
